column1: # Release table for the de-vendoring squash + tag pass.
# Consumed by Scripts/squash-release.sh. See MERGE-AND-TAG.md for the full plan.
#   repo      package repo name under github.com/brightdigit
#   wave      release wave: 0 = leaves, 1 = depends on wave 0, 2 = plugins/type layer
#   boundary  last commit to KEEP; phase-5 work above it is squashed into one commit.
#             "-" for orphan mode, where the entire history is replaced.
#   version   tag to cut, unprefixed (commit messages add the "v" prefix)
#   mode      soft   = git reset --soft <boundary>, preserves upstream history
#             orphan = git checkout --orphan, whole history becomes one root commit
#             amend  = history is already a single commit, just amend its message
#   expect_tip  main's SHA when this table was built (2026-07-27). The script aborts
#               if the remote has moved, so a boundary is never applied to newer work.
# Versions follow: a stable 1.0.0+ exists -> next major, alpha line;
#                  only a prerelease line exists -> advance that line to beta.
# 1.0.0-alpha.1 is NOT usable everywhere: it is already taken in Contribute,
# Spinetail and ContributeWordPress, and would be a semver downgrade in Files (4.3.0),
